# ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with Disaggregated CXL-Hybrid Memories

Hakbeom Jang, Younghoon Min, Sunwoong Kim, Taeyoung Ahn, Hanyee Kim,   
Youngpyo Joo, Hoshik Kim, and Jongryool Kim  Affiliation: Memory Systems Research, SK hynix

###### Abstract. [...] The performance of ITME is evaluated using the ShareGPT dataset with a configuration of 128 concurrent conversations, each spanning up to 5 turns with a minimum of 2000 tokens per conversation. As memory pressure intensifies in later stages, we focus on Turns 3–5, where the total KV cache footprint reaches 40 GB. [...] mitigates memory capacity and I/O bottlenecks through software prefetching and read-priority scheduling. Overall, ITME enhances conventional CPU-offloading by providing the necessary memory expansion to accommodate large KV cache footprints beyond host memory limits, achieving up to a 35.7% throughput improvement.
